prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by a chiropractor for a patient with neck and back strain after a car accident. Use the exact placeholder [VISITS] for the number of visits. Describe a standard plan of spinal adjustments, therapeutic exercise and electrical stimulation, and say the patient reached maximum improvement. No names, no dates.
text:
Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision with complaints of cervical and lumbar strain, including neck stiffness, reduced range of motion, paraspinal muscle tenderness, and intermittent low back pain radiating into the gluteal region without neurological deficit. Initial examination revealed restricted cervical rotation and flexion, along with palpable muscle guarding in the upper trapezius and lumbar paraspinal musculature. Neurological screening was within normal limits.

Treatment consisted of a standard plan of chiropractic spinal adjustments directed at the cervical and lumbar segments, combined with soft tissue mobilization. A progressive therapeutic exercise program focused on postural correction, core stabilization, and cervical range of motion was introduced and advanced as tolerated. Electrical stimulation was applied to the affected paraspinal muscles for pain modulation and muscle relaxation during the active treatment phase.

The patient attended a total of [VISITS] visits over the course of care. Progress was documented at each session with reassessment of range of motion, pain scores, and functional tolerance. Subjective and objective findings improved steadily and have now plateaued. The patient has reached maximum medical improvement, with residual symptoms that are stable and not expected to change significantly with further conservative care. Discharge to a independent home exercise program is recommended, with follow-up as needed for flare-ups.
